title: "Design Leadership" heading is visible after scrolling
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
expected_result: An h2 "Design Leadership" is visible when the section is scrolled into view.

title: Section content is hidden until scrolled into view and then revealed
test_data: Initial state: visibility hidden; after scroll: visible
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Without scrolling, inspect the Design Leadership content (visibility / opacity)
Scroll the section into the viewport
expected_result: Before scroll the content is not visible; after scrolling the section into view the heading and portraits become visible and remain visible when scrolling away and back.

title: Five portraits are displayed and load
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Count the portrait images in the Design Leadership carousel
expected_result: Exactly 5 portraits are present and each renders as an image (no broken-image icon).

title: Carousel can be moved horizontally to show all portraits
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Scroll or drag the carousel horizontally to the last item, then back to the first
expected_result: All 5 portraits can be reached and viewed; the carousel does not get stuck and does not cause page-level horizontal scroll.

title: [a11y] Portraits have non-empty alt text
test_data: Expected: alt attribute non-empty on all 5 portrait images (currently alt="" on all 5)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Read the alt attribute of each portrait image
expected_result: Every portrait has a non-empty, meaningful alt text (for example the person's name). Intended names/titles are an open question, so only non-empty alt is asserted.
